newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary APV to sell stake in Agrana unit.
newsitem.headline: Hungary APV to sell stake in Agrana unit.

text.p: The Hungarian privatisation agency APV Rt's board has decided to sell APV's minority stake in the sugar factory Petohazi Cukoripari Rt to a firm owned by Petohazi's management and sugar beet growers, APV said in a press release on Wednesday.

The firm, called Betacukor Befektetesi Kft, will acquire the 25.77 percent stake mainly in exchange for compensation coupons, the statement said, without indicating how many coupons it would have to pay.
Austria's Agrana owns the rest of Petohazi's shares.
APV said the deal would allow suppliers and staff to have a blocking minority of 25 percent plus one shares in Petohazi.
It added APV would like to sell similar stakes to the staff and suppliers of Hungary's other 11 sugar factories wherever possible.
Agrana, which is itself controlled by Austria's Raiffeisen and Germany's Suedzucker, has a majority stake seven Hungarian sugar factories.
Eridania Beghin-Say controls four factories and Eastern Sugar, a joint venture between Britain's Tate and Lyle and France's Groupe Saint-Louis, has a majority of the shares in one factory.
